policy: Only these enumerated auditor-authored files may be selected for public staging; no recursive directory staging. Every unlisted file is excluded by default.
source_and_original_file_policy: Original submission files outside this folder are neither authored nor authorized for publication by this allowlist; private copies and derivatives are expressly excluded.
inventory_self_reference_policy: FINAL_HASH_INVENTORY.json lists hashes of every prior public file and all excluded private files, but excludes itself and its checksum companion to avoid self-reference; FINAL_HASH_INVENTORY.sha256 seals the inventory.
